info.description: The Pharmacy Prescriptions Interactions API provides practitioners and healthcare professionals with critical insights into potential interactions between multiple prescriptions. This API enables users to retrieve detailed information on prescription interactions to enhance patient safety and promote effective medication management. Typical consumers of this API include pharmacists, doctors, and healthcare applications looking to ensure optimal patient care by preventing adverse drug interactions. By accessing this data, users can make informed decisions about prescription combinations and improve overall treatment outcomes.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed data about potential interactions between various prescriptions. It provides critical information for healthcare providers and patients to ensure safe medication practices.
